reviews.title: Great quality.
reviews.comment: Impressive value. At this price I wasn't expecting this item to be so premium. It even comes with rubber pads to dampin' vibrations. Grate durability and beautiful build quality. I'm hard pressed to find something I could reasonably complain about. They are 3 pin so they go full throttle all the time. As I use these as the bottom intake it works out well to keep my passive hardware cooler. I actually recommend running fans at different speeds. It helps with noise. These aren't too loud nor move too much air. Paired with a mesh screen to keep dust an debris out. Perfect for a bottom to top exhaust flow. Very good for thermals.
reviews.author: Noah Buskirk

reviews.comment: these fans have been great for the money in my am5 build.  they havent stopped working and barely are audible even at full speed.  they keep my 7800x3d and 7900gre nice and cool plus mount super easy with directional arrows
reviews.author: Victor

reviews.title: Great fan for the price.
reviews.comment: Don’t sleep on these fans! I bought them on a Haul deal for a PC I was building with the intention of upgrading to RGB later. Honestly, I may just leave them in there as they have been performing way better than I imagined. Airflow is good, and they are super quiet. The build quality is good, and seem very durable so far.
reviews.author: Rachael

reviews.title: Decent PC case fans
reviews.comment: Great case fans to complete your build. My only complaint was with the length of the cables, but that’s about it. They function as intended, and fit nicely even in a micro atx case. They also are not too noisy either. The installation was a bit hard for me as well, but unsure if that’s just because of the case, my inexperience with PC builds, or the product itself
reviews.author: Jacob P

reviews.title: Excellent choice if you do not need lights on your case fans
reviews.comment: Great value. I saw no advantage to lights on my PC case fans so I saved the cost. These fans fully met my expectations. They were provided with vibration insulators and mounting screws. Very quiet. Would recommend.
